newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's PM says he is ready for new elections.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's PM says he is ready for new elections.

text.p: Turkey's Islamist Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan, facing mounting challenges to his authority from the army and others in the secularist establishment, said on Tuesday he was prepared for new elections at any moment.
"Today at any moment, whoever wants it, we are ready for elections," Erbakan told his Islam-based Welfare Party.

Turkey's political leaders were scrambling on Tuesday to find a new government formula excluding Erbakan, in the midst of a row between the Islamists and the military over religious activism that threatens to topple the 10-month-old coalition.
Leftist leader Bulent Ecevit was meeting other opposition leaders later on Tuesday for talks on forming an alternative, "Islamist-free" government.
Deputy Prime Minister Tansu Ciller has so far stood by Erbakan, but his Islam-based Welfare Party has made clear it is not prepared to go along with some of the military demands.
A leading army commander earlier warned the Islamists that the military struggle against religious activism was vital to the survival of the secular republic.
